note: Arm generic: 8 item không giải phẫu, không framework. Bản 1.1 (validation của R2): ARM-GEN nhận CÙNG header route với ARM-ANA/ARM-GRD (build_prompts.py sinh OBS-GEN__<route>.txt); context_line dưới đây ('not provided') chỉ dùng cho RT-FALLBACK, nơi cả ba arm GEN/ANA/GRD đều dùng khối này.

items.name: View and orientation
items.ask: how the image is oriented and from which direction it appears to be taken

items.name: Body region shown
items.ask: which part of the body the image appears to cover

items.name: Main visible structures
items.ask: the main structures that can be seen and how they are arranged

items.name: Brightness and colour
items.ask: variations in brightness, density or colour across the image

items.name: Shapes and borders
items.ask: shapes, outlines and borders of the visible structures

items.name: Symmetry and alignment
items.ask: symmetry between sides and alignment of structures, where applicable

items.name: Focal differences
items.ask: any focal area that looks different from its surroundings, with its location

items.name: Image quality and limits
items.ask: image quality and what cannot be judged from this image
